correctness.rationale: For each g>=2, choose A=∏E_i, F_i=pr_i^*([0]), principal H=∑F_i, effective nef D=2F_1. Then 2H-D=2∑_{i>=2}F_i is a nef pullback, hence GV but not ample/IT0; H-D=-F_1+∑_{i>=2}F_i intersects the first elliptic factor curve at -1, so is not nef and not GV. Independently the Künneth cohomology support locus of (0,2,...,2) gives V^1 codimension one, while (-1,1,...,1) gives V^1 all of Pic^0, confirming GV and failure directly. The polynomial (tH-D)^g/g!=t^(g-1)(t-2) verifies the sharp numerical boundary.
